prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: deliberately unfinished web UI direction sketch for HackJudge
Primary request: Create a flat matte desktop-first web interface direction for HackJudge based on metropolitan semester-lines wayfinding. The interface must make a live semester diagram legible: one focal event connected to upcoming and past events; the active route opens into a mode-specific project or judging action; a few project story panels break through the map. It should feel like fun movement combined with professional information design.
Scene/backdrop: full desktop first viewport only, no browser chrome, no device mockup, no perspective
Subject: a HackJudge web product UI, clearly an interactive product interface rather than a rail-map poster or generic SaaS dashboard
Style/medium: deliberately unfinished high-quality UI concept sketch, flat matte editorial vector-like forms, metropolitan wayfinding information design
Composition/framing: landscape 16:10 desktop viewport; strong asymmetric web layout; slim branded header; large semester route diagram as the navigational spine; one enlarged focal event; past events visibly recede and upcoming events advance; a clear active-route branch expands into a project-building or judging work area with recognizable controls and card structure; two or three project story panels overlap or interrupt the route geometry; disciplined grid, generous porcelain negative space
Lighting/mood: no lighting effects; energetic, clear, credible, professional
Color palette: deep brand teal enamel #082f2c, porcelain #f7faf8, teal #0d9488, amber #f2b84b, coral alert #e85d5d
Materials/textures: flat enamel signage, crisp station ticks, disciplined 45-degree and 90-degree route lines, matte paper-like UI surfaces; no gradients
Text (verbatim): "HackJudge" and "Build what matters."
Text rules: those are the only two legible text strings anywhere; all other interface copy must be indistinct greeked lines, abstract bars, or unreadable placeholder marks; do not invent labels, dates, numbers, menu text, or project names
Constraints: unmistakably a web UI sketch with navigational header, interactive states, controls, cards, panels, and application workspace affordances; active route meaningfully opens into a mode-specific action; visible past/upcoming/focal event hierarchy; project story panels break through the map; intentionally exploratory and unfinished while compositionally coherent; flat orthographic front view
Avoid: rail-map poster, transit poster, generic SaaS dashboard, analytics charts, photorealism, gloss, glassmorphism, shadows, gradients, browser chrome, laptop or phone frame, device mockup, perspective, 3D, watermark, extra readable text, dense tiny typography
